text: The friendly brown puppy ran fast in the green park. He chased a bright yellow ball under the tall trees and wagged his tail happily. After a while, he rested on the soft grass.
The little girl walked to school with her blue backpack. She smiled when she saw her best friend at the gate. They walked to the classroom together and talked about their weekend.
A happy rabbit hopped across the soft green grass. It stopped near a small red flower and looked around carefully. Then it jumped behind a bush and disappeared into the garden.
The bright sun shone over the quiet town. Birds flew across the blue sky while people walked outside. Children played in the park, and families enjoyed the warm afternoon together.
Tom found a shiny red kite in his room. He took it outside and watched it fly high above the trees. The wind pushed the kite across the blue sky while Tom held the string tightly.
The small cat sat beside the warm window. She watched the birds and listened to the rain outside. After the rain stopped, she jumped down and walked quietly around the house.
My family went to the park on Sunday morning. We played games, ate sandwiches, and laughed together. My brother kicked a ball while I played with our dog near the big trees.
The young boy rode his green bicycle down the street. He wore a yellow helmet and waved to his neighbor. When he reached the park, he stopped to drink some water and rest.
A tiny blue bird landed on the old fence. It sang a cheerful song before flying into the trees. Another bird joined it, and soon both birds were singing together.
Sarah opened her lunch box at school. She found a red apple, a cheese sandwich, and a sweet cookie. She shared her cookie with her friend before going outside to play.
The brown horse ran across the wide field. Its long mane moved in the cool morning wind. When the horse reached the fence, it stopped and looked at the farmer.
We planted small flowers in our garden. The flowers grew slowly and brought many colorful butterflies. Every morning, we gave them water and checked the leaves for tiny bugs.
The children built a tall sandcastle at the beach. They used shells and small stones to decorate it. When they finished, they made a little road around the castle with their hands.
A bright orange fish swam around the little pond. It hid behind a large green plant when someone came close. After a few minutes, it came out and swam around the pond again.
Jack woke up early on Saturday morning. He opened the curtains and saw snow covering the ground. He quickly put on his warm coat and went outside to build a small snowman.
The friendly dog waited by the front door. He wanted to go outside and play with his red ball. When the door opened, he ran into the yard and jumped happily.
Emma carried a basket into the garden. She picked three ripe apples from the small tree. Then she found two more apples under the leaves and placed them carefully in her basket.
The old train moved slowly through the green hills. We looked out the window and watched the beautiful view. We saw small houses, tall trees, and a river shining in the sunlight.
A little frog jumped into the cool pond. It made a tiny splash and disappeared under the water. A few seconds later, it popped its head out and sat on a green leaf.
The boys played soccer on the school field. Their teacher watched and cheered when they scored a goal. Everyone ran across the grass and celebrated with big smiles.
Mia found a colorful book on the library shelf. She sat in a quiet chair and began to read. The story was about a brave girl who traveled to a magical forest.
The tall trees moved gently in the wind. Small leaves fell onto the brown path below. Two children walked along the path and collected their favorite leaves to take home.
Grandpa made warm pancakes for breakfast. He added fresh berries and a little honey on top. Everyone sat around the table and enjoyed the delicious breakfast together.
The family drove to the lake after lunch. They watched ducks swim near the wooden dock. Dad took pictures while the children threw small pieces of bread near the water.
A small yellow butterfly flew over the garden. It landed on a purple flower for a few seconds. Then it opened its wings and flew toward the tall green bushes.
The children played hide and seek after school. Everyone laughed when Ben hid behind the big tree. Emma found him first, and then it was her turn to hide.
Lily packed her favorite toys into a small box. She wanted to share them with her cousin. When her cousin arrived, they opened the box and played together on the floor.
The gray clouds moved across the sky. Soon, soft rain began to fall on the quiet street. People opened their umbrellas while the children watched the raindrops from the window.
A young fox walked through the forest. It stopped beside a tree and listened to the sounds around it. Then it quietly followed a narrow path toward a small stream.
The baker made fresh bread early in the morning. The warm smell filled the small shop. Customers came inside, bought bread, and thanked the baker for the delicious food.
Sam opened the garden gate and walked inside. He saw bright flowers growing beside the stone path. A small bee flew from one flower to another while Sam watched quietly.
The little girl drew a picture of her family. She used many bright colors and added a big yellow sun. When she finished, she showed the picture to her parents with a proud smile.
A playful puppy jumped into a pile of soft leaves. He rolled around and wagged his tail happily. His owner laughed and threw a small stick for him to chase.
The moon appeared above the quiet houses. The stars twinkled brightly in the dark night sky. A family sat outside for a few minutes and looked up at the beautiful stars.
We visited the farm on a sunny afternoon. We saw cows, chickens, horses, and a small brown goat. The farmer showed us the barn and told us how he cared for the animals.
The red bus stopped near the school. The children climbed aboard and found their seats. They talked quietly with their friends while the driver carefully drove through the busy streets.
A small bird built a nest in the tall tree. It carried tiny pieces of grass to make it comfortable. After several days, the nest was ready for the bird's eggs.
Daniel cleaned his room before dinner. He put his books on the shelf and his toys in a box. When everything was clean, he found his favorite toy under the bed.
The family walked along the beach at sunset. The sky turned pink, orange, and gold. The children collected small shells while their parents walked slowly beside the water.
A green frog sat on a flat rock. It watched the water and waited for a small insect. When a bug flew nearby, the frog jumped quickly and then returned to the rock.
The teacher wrote a fun story on the board. The students listened carefully and asked many questions. At the end of the lesson, everyone wrote a few sentences about the story.
Lucy baked chocolate cookies with her mother. They mixed the ingredients and placed the cookies on a tray. After baking, they waited patiently while the cookies cooled on the table.
The boy picked up his blue umbrella before leaving home. Dark clouds were growing above the town. He walked quickly to school and arrived just before the rain began.
A beautiful rainbow appeared after the rain. Everyone stopped to look at the colorful sky. The children counted the colors and tried to find the end of the rainbow.
The little mouse found a piece of cheese in the kitchen. It carried the cheese back to its tiny home. Along the way, it stopped twice to make sure the room was safe.
The children visited the zoo on a warm day. They watched the monkeys climb and the elephants eat. Before going home, they stopped to see the colorful parrots.
Mark found a smooth stone near the river. He painted it blue and gave it to his sister. She loved the little gift and placed it on her desk in her bedroom.
The wind blew gently through the garden. The colorful flowers moved from side to side. Bees flew between the flowers while the children sat nearby and enjoyed the fresh air.
Anna helped her father wash the car. They used a bucket of water and a soft yellow sponge. When the car was clean, they dried it with large towels.
The children sat under a large tree after lunch. They shared stories, played games, and enjoyed the sunny afternoon. Before going home, they cleaned the area and put their toys away.
